title: Final Temperature Limit
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct upper limit for the neutrino temperature as T < 10^6 K.

title: Neutrino Density Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the energy densities of neutrinos and photons to derive T_{nu} <= 0.1 K.

title: Expected Neutrino Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state that T_{nu} < 3 K based on the thermal equilibrium with photons.

title: Experimental Context
description: Important Criteria: The student should mention the relevant laboratory experiments and their confidence limits on neutrino interactions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all temperatures and densities are expressed with appropriate units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common mistakes such as incorrect application of the Stefan-Boltzmann law or miscalculating temperature limits.
